defects: The epimorphism is placed on the wrong morphism: `Epi q` (q : b ⟶ f, an edge connecting the assumed-commuting back face to the front face) instead of an edge into the source vertex of the face being proved to commute. In gold, `Epi f00x` is on the edge M000 ⟶ M001 landing on the source vertex (M001) of the missing face — this is essential to the proof (epi is cancelled on the left after chaining all five hypotheses). In the produced statement no edge into the goal-face's source vertex 'a' even exists (all edges at 'a' — α, δ, p — point outward), and the four connecting morphisms p,q,r,s are oriented oppositely to gold's f00x/f01x/f10x/f11x, so the epi ends up on an unrelated edge. As a result the produced theorem is not merely differently shaped — it is actually false: a concrete counterexample exists in Set (take e=f=g=h singletons, a=b=d singletons, c a 2-element set, with β and γ mapping the single point of b,d to different elements of c) that satisfies all 5 hypotheses and Epi q but violates the conclusion α≫β = δ≫γ.

Consequently the produced statement is not mathematically equivalent to the gold cube lemma; it is an unprovable/false proposition rather than a differently-labeled version of the same true statement.
